- GEN-04 | Active Listening & Issue Clarification | mandatory
  Required: Allow the customer to describe their concern without interrupting, then paraphrase the core issue to confirm mutual understanding.
  Good looks like: The agent maintains silence while the customer speaks, takes notes, and summarizes the specific problem back to the customer.
- GEN-05 | Empathy & Ownership Statement | mandatory
  Required: Express sincere empathy for the customer's inconvenience and offer personal reassurance that you will take ownership of the solution.
  Good looks like: Empathetic acknowledgment that avoids robotic stock phrases, validating the customer's frustration.
- GEN-06 | Accurate Policy Explanation & Solution Execution | mandatory, CRITICAL
  Required: State company terms, timelines, and resolutions strictly grounded in verified ShopEase policy documents.

- GEN-07 | Additional Assistance & Next Steps Summary | mandatory
  Required: Summarize the exact resolution agreed upon, reference ticket numbers, and proactively ask if there are any other questions.
  Good looks like: Clear recap of actions taken, tracking reference shared, and an open invitation for secondary questions.
- GEN-08 | Professional Branded Sign-Off | mandatory
  Required: Conclude the interaction with a warm, professional closing mentioning ShopEase.
  Good looks like: Courteous parting statement thanking the customer, waiting for the customer to disconnect first.
- HLD-01 | Request Permission and State Reason for Hold | mandatory

[REF-2.2] Method of Refund Disbursement
REF-2.2 Method of Refund Disbursement - Topics: refund, billing - Situations: identity_verification, data_disclosure - Numeric Limit: none - Default Severity: major - Kind: must_not_do 1. Refunds must be remitted strictly to the original payment method utilized during checkout: - Credit / Debit Card payments return to the identical card account. - Net Banking and UPI payments return to the source bank account. 2. Cash on Delivery (COD) Purchases: Refunds for COD orders are disbursed via NEFT bank transfer to the verified bank account or UPI VPA nominated by the customer in their account profile after completing identity verification. Refunds cannot be handed over in physical cash. 3. Under no circumstances may an agent redirect a refund to a third-party wallet or alternate bank account not registered to the customer profile.

REF-4.1 Return Logistics and Reverse Pickup - Topics: refund, shipping - Situations: none - Numeric Limit: 3 attempts - Default Severity: minor - Kind: informational 1. ShopEase reimburses courier expenses up to Rs 200 upon presentation of valid courier receipts. 3. Maximum 3 reverse pickup attempts will be made by our logistics partner before the return request is automatically cancelled.

REF-3.1 Agent Approval Authority Threshold - Topics: refund - Situations: high_value_refund, supervisor_request - Numeric Limit: Rs 5,000 - Default Severity: critical - Kind: must_not_do 1. Agents are strictly prohibited from splitting refund line items across multiple tickets to circumvent the Rs 5,000 single-agent ceiling.

REF-1.1 Return Eligibility Windows - Topics: refund, warranty - Situations: none - Numeric Limit: 7 days - Default Severity: major - Kind: informational 1. This includes smartphones, laptops, audio accessories, wearables, smart home appliances, and electronic components. - Non-Electronics Category: Exactly 14 calendar days from the date of delivery. This covers apparel, footwear, home furnishings, fitness accessories, books, and general lifestyle merchandise. 2. Items initiated past these windows are ineligible for standard returns and must be serviced via manufacturer warranty or standard repair policies.

[REF-2.1] Refund Processing Timelines
